correctness.rationale: For n≥3 and positive finite frozen conductances, set resistances r_i=1/C_i and remove candidate last vertex k. The avoided path has n−2 edges of total resistance R and start-to-endpoint part A. Resistance-coordinate hitting gives exact q_k=(1−A/R)r_k/(R+r_k)+(A/R)r_(k−1)/(R+r_(k−1)). Given the unordered multiset and the two boundary resistances, exchangeability gives E[A/R]=(n−k−1)/(n−2). By permutational symmetry each boundary normalized resistance share with n−2 others has mean 1/(n−1). Conditioning/iterated expectations yields E[q_k|multiset]=1/(n−1), including k=1,n−1, n=3 and repeated weights. All ratios are bounded; no integrability/moment issue. The annealed conditional theorem does not claim quenched uniformity.
